notes.title: There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings out now!
notes.content:
Our new project is out! If you liked the writing in A Place, Forbidden, we think you'll enjoy this as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983580/There_Swings_a_Skull_Grim_Tidings/

notes.title: THERE SWINGS A SKULL: GRIM TIDINGS RELEASING SEPTEMBER 15TH
notes.content:
Greetings! Conor here. I wanted to quickly mention that the next project I've been working on, There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings, releases in three days! If you liked my writing/the atmosphere on A Place, Forbidden, I'd be mightily glad for you to check out my newest project!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983580/There_Swings_a_Skull_Grim_Tidings/

[i]Enter the doomed town of Pareildas. Watch as the flames turn bone and stone to ash. Like joined wicks, we'll all burn together.[/i]

Looking forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Wishlist There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings now!
notes.content:
Howdy there! Conor here, writer-man and generalist on A Place, Forbidden.

I wanted to let you folks know that I've been hard at work with another Excellent Team on an upcoming project known as There Swings a Skull, Grim Tidings! 

Wishlisting it would help us out immensely!


[b]THERE SWINGS A SKULL[/b]
[i]Enter the doomed town of Pareildas. Watch as the flames turn bone and stone to ash. Like joined wicks, we'll all burn together.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983580/There_Swings_a_Skull_Grim_Tidings/


If you like fantastic pixel art, an oppressive, unnatural atmosphere, eerie music, flesh-spiders, [redacted], immolation, and vengeful all-powerful gods to whom we are less than ants, There Swings a Skull is, perhaps, for you.


I'm of the opinion that the writing in TSAS is some of my best work, and I'm excited to share it with you all!

It'd help our team out immensely if you'd be willing to wishlist our upcoming project! We've put a lot of love (and a conspicuous amount of blood) into it!

Much obliged.
-Conor

notes.title: A Place, Forbidden Update 20200630
notes.content:
The previous update still had some remaining issues with achievement unlocks and the notebook which came down to conflicts with save data. Thank you to BabblingFishes and The Stranger for sending us reports which got us on the right track for solving the problem.

All Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed save data conflict when doing certain actions in a specific order
[*] Fixed notebook progress sometimes getting reset
[*] Fixed unlocks for the following achievements: "Doomed", "All the Pieces - But to What?", "Keen Eyed"
[*] Fixed some objects displaying placeholder text when inspecting
[*] Fixed FPS drop down resetting to 60 after being set to Unlimited
[*] Fixed player collision with vent in Room 2
[*] Fixed post processing issue that caused shiny materials to flicker and appear too bright
[/list]

Thank you for your patience! If you find any more issues with the game, please let us know in the Bug Reports forum.

notes.title: A Place, Forbidden Update 20200626
notes.content:
As some of you have noticed, achievements didn't properly unlock in the release version of [i]A Place, Forbidden[/i]. This hotfix should solve this and a few additional minor bugs.

All Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed majority of achievements not unlocking
[*]Changed name and unlock conditions of one achievement
[*]Fixed bug where the keybinding menu could get stuck on the screen
[*]Fixed typos
[*]Adjusted volume of a few sound files
[/list]
